title: TrackingProjectLinks
description: A project's MLflow experiment and its read-only imported experiments.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

experiment_id.title: MlflowExperimentId
experiment_id.description: Set once MLflow acknowledges the project experiment.

items.title: ImportedExperiment
items.description: A historical MLflow experiment linked to a project read-only. Never rewritten.

experiment_id.title: MlflowExperimentId
experiment_id.description: MLflow experiment ID, as MLflow returns it.

linked_at.title: Timestamp
linked_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.
